# Read-back

A brunch for four people must be completely ready and on the table by 10:00 AM. The menu consists of oven-baked bacon (one pound, 20 minutes at 400°F with a pan turn at the halfway point), pancakes made from scratch (dry ingredients mixed, wet ingredients beaten, combined and rested 10 minutes, then cooked in batches on a griddle for about 15 minutes total), a fresh fruit salad (10 minutes prep, then chilled for at least 15 minutes), and coffee (3 minutes setup and grinding, then 8 minutes brewing, timed to finish when the pancakes come off). The cook must work alone, and the critical equipment constraints are one oven (used only for bacon), two burners (one for the griddle, one available or needed for coffee heating), and the griddle itself. Several steps have timing dependencies: the pancake batter must rest while the bacon cooks, the fruit salad must chill for at least 15 minutes before serving, and the coffee must finish brewing precisely as the pancakes finish cooking so everything comes hot to the table.
